text:
alex (support): heads-up: multiple hosted inference tenants in eu-west-2 are reporting 502/504s and request timeouts starting ~08:12 UTC. High customer impact, tickets piling up. Any network or infra alerts? :rotating_light:

maya (ingest-sre): confirmed spike in 5xx and p95+p99 latency at eu-west-2 edge LBs around 08:10. Correlates with TCP layer errors toward our transit. Ran mtr and saw intermittent loss.

maya (ingest-sre): ```
mtr -r -c 30 edge-eu-west2 -> transit-peer
1 10.1.0.1 0.0% 0.7ms
2 192.168.10.1 0.0% 1.1ms
3 203.0.113.99 0.0% 4.8ms
4 198.51.100.77 7.5% 10.2ms  <-- microbursts
5 198.51.100.81 9.6% 13.5ms
6 198.51.100.90 0.0% 14.0ms
```
Loss concentrated on provider hop 4-5, intermittent.

luca (netops): BGP flaps logged from transit ASN AS64599 at 08:08-08:14, multiple withdraws. Opening ticket with provider NOC (PV-7791). They acknowledge and are investigating.

josh (eng-runtime): runtime symptoms: KV cache churn causing longer path lookups, and some TCP RSTs causing gateway to return 502s quickly. Streaming endpoints particularly affected due to many long-held connections.

alex (support): noticed some failures during token exchange (oauth). Might be timeouts in front of auth service.

sarah (oncall-bot): INC-2026-489 created by alex (support) at 08:18 UTC. Priority P1. Paginated list notified.

maya (ingest-sre): tcpdump from edge during window shows dup acks and retransmits, then occasional RSTs from peer side. snippet: 

maya (ingest-sre): ```
08:08:12.512 IP edge -> peer: Flags [P.], seq 2345:2460, ack 1001
08:08:12.513 IP peer -> edge: Flags [R], seq 1001, ack 2345  <-- RST
08:08:12.520 IP edge -> peer: retransmission
```

luca (netops): provider says recent config push caused a control-plane overload on PE routers; they're rolling a hotfix. ETA initial mitigation: 15-25m.

josh (eng-runtime): suggested mitigations: 1) steer new sessions to eu-west-1 via smart-router, 2) bump gateway read timeout temporarily, 3) start shedding or queueing streaming sessions. Thoughts?

maya (ingest-sre): prefer traffic steering for new sessions only to avoid cache invalidation for existing live sessions. We can change route preference to alternate transit.

alex (support): i'll prepare a status posts for customers and advise retry/backoff for transient 502s. Also warn about possible routing/regional differences.

luca (netops): applied BGP local-preference override to prefer backup transit AS64521 for our eu-west-2 prefixes. Provider confirms traffic is moving; watching for asymmetric return paths.

josh (eng-runtime): pushed routing override in smart-router: rule -> if src_region==eu-west-2 and route_health<0.92 then prefer eu-west-1 for new connections. Deployment in 45s.

deployment-bot: deployment josh/smart-router/2026.4 initiated — rolling out to control-plane fleet

maya (ingest-sre): after reroute ~70% of new sessions now hit eu-west-1. eu-west-2 5xx rate falling but p99 still elevated for some flows.

customer-john (external): thanks, errors reduced substantially. We still see sporadic 502s on heavy batch jobs though.

luca (netops): provider applied fix at 08:42 UTC and reports BGP stability restored. We'll keep the pref change for 1 hour to let caches warm and prevent oscillation.

josh (eng-runtime): note on billing: traffic crossing regions may affect egress billing for some customers. Finance flagged possibility. alex, please include note in customer comms.

alex (support): posting status.redwood.ai update now with summary, mitigation steps, and follow-up RCA promise. Drafting email to impacted customers.

sarah (oncall-bot): INC-2026-489 updated: mitigation in place, provider fix confirmed. Monitoring for 60m. Followups assigned: netops/luca (RCA with provider) and eng-runtime/josh (routing/fallback playbook).

maya (ingest-sre): repro steps for engineering: 1) send high-concurrency streaming traffic to /v1/chat/completions in eu-west-2 (~2k concurrent) 2) observe gateway 502s and TCP resets 3) run mtr/tcpdump edge -> transit to capture microburst pattern

josh (eng-runtime): next actions: a) test canary with session-stickiness off to speed cache rebuild if we reroute, b) add transit-loss metric to edge LBs, c) codify routing override runbook in playbooks repo.

luca (netops): will keep PV-7791 open and request provider postmortem and potential SLA credit guidance.

alex (support): closing incident thread for now; will reopen if regression. Posting customer updates. :white_check_mark:
